notes: Capture the Flag as a Slayer game mode, rewritten as host rules: flags stand on Flag Spawn bricks in their team's colour; take an enemy flag to your own flag or a Flag Return Point to score; enough captures win the round; dropped flags go home after a while; /dropFlag drops a carried flag. Its brick events (onFlagPickedUp, onFlagDropped, onFlagReturned, onFlagRecovered) are in the wrench for builders to wire. The flag waves where it stands and rides on the carrier's back in their team colour. Its settings are with Slayer's in the Mini-Game window's Add-On Settings, shown when the game mode is Capture the Flag. Not ported yet: the Drop Tool key dropping the flag, the countdown over a dropped flag, the flag's light, locked flags, the score list columns and bots.
